description: A Quire document: owner adds Bea and Cal, everyone writes, the owner compacts, removes Cal (epoch 1) and writes again; Mallory, who holds the link but is not a member, writes a valid encrypted epoch 0 update with new text; Bea writes one epoch 1 update whose header has t as a string, which readers must ignore. Keys are synthetic test values. Entities use the arkiv_query JSON shape: attributes as [{name, type, value}], u64 as 0x hex.

privateKeys.note: Bea's key unwraps epoch 1; the owner's key opens join requests. Synthetic: never use these keys anywhere real.

expected.memberText:
Minutes, synthetic test document.
Bea adds a line.
Cal adds a line before being removed.
Written in epoch 1, after Cal left.
